Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the time last week — the performance gains you shared were super helpful. We put together a short draft case study that highlights the latency and cost improvements after migrating a subset of your inference workload to Redwood Dedicated.

Attached is the draft (redwood_draft_case_study_v1.pdf). Can you confirm whether Capitol Health is comfortable with: 1) Redwood using the Capitol Health name and the logo in marketing materials, and 2) a short quote attributed to you (we proposed the sentence in the doc)?

Thanks — happy to adjust based on your guidance.

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for sharing — we appreciate the clarity. Quick answers: Capitol Health is generally OK with being profiled, and the quote looks fine as a starting point, but Marketing will need to review brand usage and placement. I pulled in our marketing team on this thread.

A couple of asks from our side before formal sign-off:
- Please provide your final logo file (vector) and usage mockups (where the logo will appear on web and PDF).
- We need to review the full quote attribution: can we make it "Alex Rivera, Director of Data Platforms, Capitol Health"?
- We prefer to go through DocuSign for official permission.

I'll ask Marketing to review the attached draft and the mockups when you send them.

Best,
Alex
